free_tier.stated: 100 tokens per day, maximum 10 per minute, with no registration and no full text; 1,000 tokens per day, maximum 25 per minute, for a registered personal user; 5,000 tokens per day, maximum 10 per minute, for a registered academic user; a simple query costs 1 token, complex ones 3 to 5
free_tier.notes: The unit is CORE's API token, a per-call credit, not a model token. The service page heading 'Unlimited access' introduces harmonised access across CORE's providers and is not a rate; the same page states one batch request or five single requests per 10 seconds.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: JSON per query, with download endpoints that return the stored PDF. A one-record search response measured 2,091 bytes.

retention.stated: the index is rebuilt from provider repositories; full texts live at the provider, so a CORE download can stop resolving when a repository changes

egress.terms: Free. The API key is a free registration, not a purchase; no price appears on the service page.

interface_detail: GET https://api.core.ac.uk/v3/search/works?q=...&limit=N with an Authorization: Bearer header; separate endpoints for outputs, data providers and full-text download.
chaining: A full-text aggregator that overlaps Europe PMC and PMC on biomedical content but also covers humanities and social science repositories those two miss.

limits.value: unauthenticated: 100 tokens per day, maximum 10 per minute, no full text; registered personal user: 1,000 tokens per day, maximum 25 per minute; registered academic user: 5,000 tokens per day, maximum 10 per minute

limits_note: The API reference states that access needs no authentication and that full text is not available to unauthenticated users; a key from the registration form, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {apikey}', raises the allowance. A simple query costs 1 token and a complex one 3 to 5.
binding_note: At 1 token for a simple query the unauthenticated allowance is 100 queries a day at most 10 a minute, and a registered personal key 1,000 a day at most 25 a minute; complex queries cost 3 to 5 tokens and lower both.

identity_cost.detail: The API answers with no registration, without full text. A free API key, sent as a Bearer token, comes from a form that asks for an email address (an institutional one when registering in an institutional capacity), and the key is sent to that address.

reliability_note: A full-text link can rot on the provider side even while the CORE record survives; the aggregator's copy is a pointer, not a mirror.
confidence_note: The API reference and the service page were read on 2026-10-31, and an anonymous search answered 200 with an x-ratelimit-limit header of 10 the same day. No key was requested, so the registered allowances are documented, not measured.
